title: Vision-Language Models Are Joint Denoisers in Robotic Action Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.01215v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Diffusion-based vision-language-action (VLA) models cascade pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) with diffusion action experts, but typically restrict the VLM to providing static conditioning. This separation limits how much pretrained perception and reasoning can guide action generation, especially in out-of-distribution settings. We introduce JADE, a Joint Action DEnoiser that enables the VLM and action expert to jointly refine actions. Our key insight is that structured action latents allow the VLM to read the current noisy action together with visual observations and language instructions. At every denoising step, the VLM contextualizes the noisy action and guides the action expert through gated cross-attention, so that its guidance evolves with the action being generated. translated_title: 视觉-语言模型在机器人动作生成中充当联合去噪器
translated_abstract: 基于扩散的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型将预训练的视觉-语言模型（VLM）与扩散动作专家级联，但通常将视觉-语言模型限制为仅提供静态条件信息。这种分离限制了预训练的感知与推理能力对动作生成的引导程度，尤其是在分布外场景中。我们提出了JADE（联合动作去噪器），使视觉-语言模型与动作专家能够联合精炼动作。我们的关键洞察是：结构化的动作潜变量使视觉-语言模型能够将当前含噪动作与视觉观察和语言指令一同读取。在每个去噪步骤中，视觉-语言模型对含噪动作进行上下文化理解，并通过门控交叉注意力引导动作专家，使其引导随正在生成的动作而动态演变。我们进一步监督视觉-语言模型从含噪动作潜变量中恢复干净的动作潜变量，这为其提供了直接的动作学习信号，并将感知与动作学习耦合起来。
tldr: 提出JADE方法，让视觉-语言模型在每个去噪步骤中读取含噪动作并通过门控交叉注意力动态引导动作专家，使预训练的感知与推理能力与动作生成实现联合去噪，显著提升分布外场景下的机器人操作表现。
en_tdlr: JADE turns vision-language models into joint denoisers that read the noisy action at every denoising step and dynamically guide diffusion action experts via gated cross-attention, unleashing pretrained perception and reasoning for robotic action generation.
